openQuestions.text: Should ANCHORS_VALID implement the documented no-nesting rule, or should validation-rules.md drop it?
Does the archive post-move step need both repair-derived and migrate-generated-json to settle METADATA_DISK_PATH_CONSISTENCY end to end?
Does the never-change-prose contract permit aligning implementation-summary status to spec.md, or must the conflict stay reported?

resolvedQuestions.text: Which one-off repair fixes should become permanent idempotent tooling, and where should each live?
What causes each validation failure class at the source, and how do we stop new instances?
How should an older or pre-v4 repo be detected and migrated or healed safely, and how does that fit /doctor:update?
What should be hardened in this branch's own changes: the CI rebuild job, the cleanup tools, the seeder, the Gate 3 wording and the token push?
Which checks belong in CI or pre-commit so drift is caught early and cheaply?

keyFindings.statement: templates/core/spec.md.tmpl opens ANCHOR:questions at line 184 and closes it at 399 (Level 1/2/3) and 425 (Level 3+), nesting nfr, edge-cases and complexity inside it in every rendered Level 2/3 spec.md.
ANCHORS_VALID checks pairing and duplicates only; the documented no-nesting rule is not implemented, so the template nesting does not fail validation.
archive.sh and restore_spec move packets and refresh only the track root; the moved packet's recorded paths keep pre-move values, the producer of the 2,898-occurrence path-drift class.

upgrade-legacy.mjs already runs a staged migration (fill-frontmatter, heal-spec-docs, repair-derived, migrate-generated-json) with dry-run default and an upgrade-baseline.json grandfather ledger; specFolder and frontmatter-field one-offs are already owned.
The trigger-index workflow stages only the index while the generator writes four outputs; no post-commit check exists.
The 20 template-default phrases live in the templates, phrase-judge.mjs and create.sh; Gate 3 menu wording is inlined despite exported constants across a 34-file copy surface.

Pre-v4 is a bundle of eras measured in this corpus: resource-map v1.1 headers (224), three implementation-summary header spellings, 74 archived packets without description.json, 77 without graph-metadata.json.
